description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Phyrexian Metamorph.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Phyrexian Metamorph and another permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Metamorph by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Phyrexian Metamorph
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
